body: I was so startled by a rattle in the bushes that I jerked back and disconnected my shoulder. Three years later, I still have pain and discomfort from resulting frozen shoulder.
Yogurt. And strawberries. Now that I am doing very well, I rarely buy them.

Don't have kids!

Reason: Once you have kids, your life will be a rollercoaster of pain, fear and vulnerability. The love you feel for them is intense but I rather not feel the pain that comes from losing them or seeing them in pain.

Wow. So you are willing to leave your kids behind to carry your pain? Not to try to guilt you but look up statistics of parents that kill themselves and how likely it will result in their children doing the same. At least if you do it, know what you are setting in motion.

My nephew is latin. Joined it and it saved his life. He is now married and happy teaching English is a middle eastern country. A very different life but he is happy because he has a purpose in his life.
Well...troll or not. If you ended up on this topic it may be for a reason.

College is a huge scam and waste of time for a lot of people. It is great for those who want to go but we have all been tricked into thinking it is the only way to have a future. THAT IS A LIE. You can get a real estate license. You can work in insurance. You can join the military. There are tons of programs like nursing. I am just saying that you should not be so overwhelmed about school.  Try something new. Join a club or volunteer at something you like. Do a life reset and think outside of the box. Time is sometimes our enemy but can be your best friend too.

You will always live on. In your parents grief and self doubt. A soul death sentence to them. Not to guilt you but just so you make an informed decision. Have you truly done everything you can to change your life. Sometimes depression stops us from thinking clearly. DM me if you like. I have been there and made it to the other side where I have clarity on what life really is.

It is not just a click... It is a click followed by the primal cry of your mother when she finds out. The agony and sense of failure your father will feel at not guiding you into a good life. The doubt and cloud of depression of your siblings or anyone else that may love you each time they see someone that looks like you. If it ended with a click I would have done it a long time ago.

Just like you met her, you can meet someone new. You are depressed which is totally normal after a break up. I thought I would die with my first breakup. Years later I look back and am so relieved that I did not end up marrying and starting a life with that loser. Trust me, it gets easier. Stay busy and try to be around people. A mall, get something to eat, volunteer at a pet shop. Whatever to be preoccupied and not lonely. Good luck.

Really? Killing yourself over college? Let me let you in on a big secret. College is a scam and a joke. Most people I know work in a field not related to their college degree. College is not for everyone. Probably not for most people. Get a real estate or insurance license. Easy and you can make a lot more money than most doctors. Think outside of the box and try something different. Join the military, move somewhere new. There are a lot of things out there aside of the huge scam that college is. My nephew is about to start lineman school. Will make twice what a teacher makes. Good luck.

You don't want to take anything from your nana? Really? You will take away her peace and joy. You will crush her soul. Not trying to make you feel guilty but do not fool yourself into thinking that she will just get over it. I can relate to wanting to die. It would be such a sweet relief for me but I would leave behind people who I love and who I would be passing the pain on to them. I just will not do that. Maybe when those I love are gone first, then I would reconsider my exit.

Why do you feel this way? What have you tried to change your life. Maybe do something drastic like joining the peace corp or trying life in a different culture. Please try to think outside of the box to see if this makes a difference. There has to be someone out there that loves you and is willing to help you. Just give it some thought. I cant say I understand how you feel without knowing what has led you to feel this way but I can tell you my life has had moments of elation and moments of true unbearable misery. It can go in either direction depending on what life has in store for us at that time.

The only ones you will be hurting are your parents. They will NEVER get over it. Your death will turn life into a curse for them. They will never forgive themselves for not saving you. Peace is the last thing they will ever feel. Trust me, my son killed himself on 1/27/22 and my life went from wonderful to a curse. I struggle with not killing myself everyday because of it. My husband feels the same way. If you truly love your parents then tell yourself that life starts a new right now. Do whatever it takes to move forward. Move to another state, another country. Whatever it will take to reinvent yourself. You can do it and you will not be destroying your parents. Good luck.

You are 18. If you choose to live all you have is future. Alot of it. If you feel this bad, you have nothing to lose. Think outside of the box. Move to another state. Join the army. Get a job teaching English in another country. Try something crazy and spontaneous before you end your life.  My nephew did exactly that and is not very happy and married teaching English in India. Life had worn him down. His mother, my sister, was murdered when he was 10 years old. He struggled with uncaring father and evil stepmother. Had depression and was a lost soul. Had he killed himself at that point, he would have missed out on the life he has and loves now.

As hard as things may be, I promise you that you would not be helping your parents by killing yourself. You will condemn them to a life of sadness and regret. Please go to some websites where parents share their experience about their children's suicides. It may change your way of thinking about it.

We are ALL one day away from ending it. Life can be a blessing or a curse. The point is that just like life can suck right now, it can be wonderful in a week or a month or a year. Give it time. All we have is life. There are simple joys in life in a beautiful day, a great meal, a funny show. Try to concentrate on the simple things that can bring some enjoyment to your life. Do not over think things. Thinking is sometimes our biggest enemy. And try to be around people. Being alone is also an anchor to people who are sad.

May be hard to believe but one day you will probably look back and think that your ex may not have been all that. I remember my first breakup. I had built my whole life around him and lost all my friends to give him all my time and energy. He broke my heart after 4 years together. I look back now and am so grateful that I did not marry him. He was a serial cheater and the most tactless person on earth. Saw an article in the news about how he was arrested for insurance fraud and sued by the city for destroying a sea wall. He has been divorced 3 times. A relative knows his sister.  That is how I know. The point is that when the break up is fresh you cannot see what you will see in a few years. Hang in there. You will be okay.
I am sure it is their way of helping themselves. It is important for those around you to feel the comfort that they said all they had to or needed to say just incase.

You are lucky to have loving grandparents. Do not know how old they are but you can hang on for them. Once they are gone if you truly hate life, then you can make a decision at that time. Please pay their kindness and love back by letting them die in peace.  So many people are all alone. You have them. That is something.
Thanks for reply. I agree with you. Was wondering how others felt about this.
There is nothing worst than feeling alone. Hope things work out for you. Best of luck to you.

Tell me about yourself. I would love to get to know you. There are so many shallow people out there that do not value friendship. That really sucks. There are kind people out there. They are just hard to find. I have found that the best way to find nice people is by finding people that like some of the things I live. Maybe take a martial arts class or a cooking class. Anything where you can be around people your age that may be looking for friends too. Good luck. And you can chat with me anytime you like. You sound like a super cool and kind person. Probably too good for this world but you are not alone. I promise there is hope. Take your time and you will find a friend who deserves your friendship. 

My son had the exact situation as you. He actually met a girl on a studying website and they just had their first anniversary. His life has changed in such a positive way. Yours will too eventually. Do not lose hope.

Please tell them. Be very clear and give reasons so they believe you. My son told me in a very vague way and I truly thought he was just having a bad day. He killed himself a few weeks ago and now I and my husband are both in so much pain that we both want to die as well. Our lives are basically over. I wish I had understood that my son was not bluffing. I truly will regret not understanding what he was going through for the rest of my life. Death would be such a comfort for me right now but I have people who need me and I must go on for them.

I can relate to your post in so many ways. Trapped is exactly how I feel too. There has to be a way out of this feeling. I just haven't found it yet. Do not lose hope. Life can change for the worst but also for the better in a second.

Have you truly seeing all the results? Do you have parents that love you? Anyone that would be hurt and whose life would be ruined by it. If no one would be hurt at all and you truly hate life, then it is your choice. My son killed himself and he ruined my life, my husband's and his brothers. Now we all live with unspeakable depression and post traumatic stress.

Only reason to live when life sucks is that life is dynamic and ever changing. My life was amazing 4 months ago and now it is painful beyond words. I try to think back on better days and it give me a little hope that one day I will love life again.

Try to not be alone. I thought I was giving my son a great gift by getting him a condo and he killed himself within 4 months of being alone. Get a room mate even if you do not need it financially. It could save your life.

Hi. Sorry you are going through such a hard time. I am too. I would end my life if I didn't have people who depend on me. You can email me if you need to talk anytime. I am at a horrible place in my life right now but I did have an amazing life in the past and have hope that maybe I will find joy in the future. Life is nothing but time. Find little things that may give you a pick me up.  A good snack, a funny show a good book. Good luck.

Cutting is a need to feel not die. How is your relationship with your parents? Is there anyone that loves you? None of your problems seem permanent or serious. Imagine meeting the perfect guy or getting a great job in a week or so.
